Understand today. Design what comes next.

An experience, interface and accessibility audit guiding the evolution of a property-management platform.

THE STARTING POINT

Residents, property managers and service teams share a platform with multiple modules and dependencies. Before modernizing it, that complexity needed to be made visible.

The challenge

Build a clear reference of the current state to support migration to a modern frontend framework and a scalable design system.

The solution

I mapped architecture, functionality and As-Is scenarios. The UX/UI audit organized findings by severity, while user flows and accessibility analysis helped prioritize improvements.
